# viettelcloud_volume_backup_policy (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud Block Storage volume backup policy by ID or exact filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_volume_backup_policy" "periodic" {
  name   = "example-periodic"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Backup policy ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Backup policy name to filter by.
- `region` (String) Project region name to filter by.
- `status` (String) Policy status to filter by: enabled or disabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Backup policy description.
- `last_execution` (String) Time of the latest backup run (RFC3339). Null before the first run.
- `next_execution` (String) Time of the next backup (RFC3339). Null when none is planned.
- `retention` (Number) Number of backups that the policy keeps for each volume.
- `schedule` (Attributes) When the policy takes backups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `state` (String) State of the latest backup run.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of volumes that use the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `days_of_month` (Set of Number) Days of the month on which the policy takes a backup. Null with `periodic`.
- `execution_strategy` (String) Schedule type: periodic or days_of_month.
- `first_execution` (String) Time of the first backup (RFC3339). Null with `days_of_month`.
- `frequency` (Number) Number of frequency units between two backups. Null with `days_of_month`.
- `frequency_unit` (String) Unit of `frequency`: day, week, or month. Null with `days_of_month`.
- `time` (String) Time of day in UTC at which the policy takes a backup. Null with `periodic`.
